accuracy.evidence: Checked: 66 million years (Renne et al. 2013 dated the boundary at 66.04 Ma), asteroid about 10 km wide and Chicxulub about 180 km wide under the Yucatán Peninsula (Hildebrand et al. 1991; Schulte et al. 2010), iridium about 30 times background in the Gubbio boundary clay (Alvarez et al. 1980), shocked quartz and glass spherules in the clay, about three quarters of species lost, birds as the surviving dinosaurs and pterosaurs as non-dinosaur reptiles, Meteor Crater 1.2 km and about 50,000 years, Manicouagan about 100 km and 214 million years. The Hell Creek-style cliff is labelled as 'like' that site, and the iridium meter uses relative units stated in the data file. Deccan Traps volcanism is named as still debated.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets the documented mistakes: the asteroid hit every dinosaur directly (food-chain predict and challenge 'direct'), no dinosaurs survived (birds predict, sorter feedback, challenge 'none'), pterosaurs are dinosaurs (sorter and challenge 'ptero'), top layers are oldest (layer predict and challenge 'topold'), all life died (mastery m6), and volcanoes disprove the impact (challenge 'lava').

lab_distinct.evidence: The lab follows this event's own chain of evidence: dig a dated cliff to the clay where dinosaur fossils stop, probe the iridium spike, match the crater by age and size, order the impact-winter collapse, sort K-Pg victims and survivors, and build an animal from real survivor traits. gate_lab_distinct passed (under 30% shingle overlap with every other flagship lab, including flagmeso and flagfossev).

lab_teaches.evidence: The learner discovers each fact before the text states it: the dinosaur bones visibly stop at the clay, the meter jumps from 1 to 30 only in the clay, Meteor Crater and Manicouagan are rejected by their own size and age labels, and the survivor builder shows the chance meter rising only with small size, seeds/insects/detritus and a burrow or fresh water.

predictions.evidence: Four locked predictions with a tempting wrong option, each disproved in the lab: top layers oldest (the dig shows dinosaur bones deep and the ages appear), iridium from sea water or bones (the spike sits in a bone-free clay), asteroid rocks hit each dinosaur (the chain shows starvation after the Sun is blocked), no dinosaurs survived (birds sort into Survived with the reason).

challenge_feedback.evidence: Eight rotating challenge questions with 13 distinct feedback messages naming the slip: 6,600 vs 66 million years, Earth's formation, bones vs iridium in the clay, volcanoes as the only cause, Meteor Crater location, direct-hit idea, running away, pterosaurs vs birds, no survivors, oldest layer on top, thickness vs age, and big leaf-eaters.

readability.evidence: validate_lessons.py passed the learner readability limits (kid at most 6.5, adult at most 9.5). Kid paragraphs use short sentences and explain iridium, crater and food chain in plain words; key terms (iridium, Chicxulub, Cretaceous) are introduced once each with a meaning.

no_filler.evidence: gate_content passed the filler patterns and the 12% duplicate limit against all 970 lessons (970 Mesozoic only names the asteroid in passing). Every paragraph carries a fact, a piece of evidence or a named mistake; no lesson-opening or closing throat-clearing.

mobile.evidence: Screenshots at 360 px (Android, 2x) for all seven steps in light and dark themes and gate_browser on iPhone 13 and 1200 px desktop. After the first pass the probe step's fossil notes ran past the narrower cliff into the meter and the sorter card clipped 'Tyrannosaurus'; the probe step now shows layer names only, layer notes wrap inside their band, and the card is wider. Crater circles now scale linearly with width.

accessibility.evidence: gate_browser passed: axe (WCAG 2.1 AA) clean in both themes on desktop and iPhone 13, all six tasks complete with Show me, no console errors. Every canvas action has a button (Dig down one layer, a button per layer, Probe up, Probe down, This layer is highest, Drop on each crater, a button per chain card, Died out and Survived, a button per survivor trait), and the canvas aria-label is rewritten after each action with the layer found, the iridium reading or the feedback.
